---
description: Authoring conventions for the ddlapi schema model and DDL parser.
applyTo: "src/**/*.ts"
---

## Skill trigger: `ddlapi-authoring`

When editing the ddlapi library sources under `src/**` — the schema model
(`schema.ts`, `types.ts`, `attrs.ts`, `exprs.ts`, `constants.ts`,
`factories.ts`, `utils.ts`) or the DDL parser (`src/parser/**`) — apply the
`ddlapi-authoring` skill.
